name: Spiral
summary: One line through points stepped by a slowly drifting angle; morphs between arms, rosettes and stars.
credit: After the spirals in Sonia Boller's audible-visuals (https://github.com/soniaboller/audible-visuals, Apache License 2.0). The idea only; no code ported.
hint: One line through points stepped round by an angle; as the step drifts, the figure passes through arms, rosettes and stars. Each beat sends a pulse of light out along the line, and each section of the song gives it colours of its own. As much as the layer's Motion says, the waveform pushes the points in and out, harder on the beat, and it sways once a bar.

params.label: Shape
params.help: Spiral and Rose follow the angle step. Wavy and Flower scatter the points into rosettes that morph as the angle drifts; Circle is a ring seen from above, lifted by the waveform (the last three after Sonia Boller's spiral page).

params.label: Reacts
params.help: How bright the pulse of light each beat sends along the line is, and (with Motion) how hard beats and drops push the points.

params.label: Sections
params.help: How far each section of the song moves the colours along the palette: a section that comes back gets its colours back.

params.label: Bar sway
params.help: How far the figure turns to and fro once a bar, as much as the beat is sure and the layer's Motion says.
